name: CEO Orchestrator
description: Agent #0 (head). Receives every company-wide event (lead, discovery, website build, failures, approvals), routes it to the responsible agent by a fixed routing table, opens exception/approval tasks for humans, keeps the unresolved-issues list, writes the Management view into the vault every hour and serves the Approval Inbox. Deterministic: no LLM, no customer contact, no money.
routes: OC_ROUTES in orchestrator.js (event type -> agent, action, severity, notify)
may_autonomously: route an event to the responsible agent
open or reopen an exception task (task_type exception, assigned to human)
open a review task for lead.human_review
email the owner about a failure or a re-auth need (never in test_mode)
compute the unresolved-issues list and rewrite the Management view note
close/recover/reopen/cancel a task when the owner does it in the inbox with the PIN
write audit rows and agent-run rows
must_escalate: every approval (customer reply, proposal, pricing) - it only lists them and links to the Approve Reply gate
any exception it cannot resolve by re-routing (all of them, v1)
never: move money, publish a website, change a credential
become a source of truth (tasks/leads/runs live in the CEO Brain tables)
drop an event silently (unknown types are logged as notes)
use an LLM (v1 is fully deterministic)
